look: Amberhide Grazer, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Amberhides family: placid deer-like grazer with amber plates along its back. Family anatomy: stocky horned grazing beasts like aurochs with amber plates growing through their hide. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are honey amber. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, small subtle stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
